name: Kirkland Signature Bath Tissue, 2-Ply, 380 Sheets, 30 Rolls

name: Kirkland Signature Napkins, 1-Ply, 280-count, 4-pack
description: Kirkland Signature Napkins are 1-ply napkins sold as a 4-pack with 280 napkins in each pack. The warehouse pack is intended for everyday meals and household entertaining.

name: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean HE Liquid Laundry Detergent, 146 loads, 194 fl oz
description: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean HE Liquid Laundry Detergent is a 194 fl oz bottle rated for 146 loads. The formula is listed as a fresh scent with tough stain fighting power. It is sold as a single liquid container.

name: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean Free & Clear HE Liquid Laundry Detergent, 146 loads, 194 fl oz
description: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean Free & Clear HE Liquid Laundry Detergent is a 194 fl oz bottle for 146 loads. Costco lists it as hypo-allergenic and tough on stains, with a Free & Clear scent. It is a single liquid container.

name: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean HE Laundry Detergent Pacs, 152-count
description: Kirkland Signature Ultra Clean HE Laundry Detergent Pacs are pre-measured pacs for 152 loads, with 127 oz total. The page lists a refreshing scent, Catch & Release Technology to isolate dirt and stains, and use in all washing machines and water temperatures. Add one pac to the drum for most loads, or two for heavily soiled loads; do not unwrap pacs or put them in an HE dispenser drawer.

name: Kirkland Signature Flex-Tech 13-Gallon Kitchen Trash Bag, 200-count
description: Kirkland Signature Flex-Tech 13-Gallon Kitchen Trash Bags are white drawstring bags sold in a 200-count pack. Flex-Tech plastic is described as expanding around trash to reduce tears and increase holding capacity. The gripping drawstring expands around the can and contracts to keep the bag in place, and the bags are reinforced at the top.

name: Kirkland Signature Flex-Tech 33-Gallon Trash Bag, 90-count
description: Kirkland Signature Flex-Tech 33-Gallon Trash Bags come in a 90-count pack with a drawstring closure. The page states the bags are made with 20% post-consumer recycled plastics.

name: Kirkland Signature 18-Gallon Compactor & Kitchen Trash Bag, 70-count
description: Kirkland Signature 18-Gallon Compactor & Kitchen Trash Bags are white drawstring bags in a 70-count pack. The page lists 2.0 mil thickness, 25.625 by 28 inch dimensions, 20% post-consumer recycled plastics, and Made in USA.

name: Kirkland Signature Alkaline AA Batteries, 48-count
description: Kirkland Signature Alkaline AA Batteries are sold in a 48-count warehouse pack. These are alkaline batteries in AA size for household devices.

name: Kirkland Signature Alkaline AAA Batteries, 48-count
description: Kirkland Signature Alkaline AAA Batteries are a 48-count pack of AAA alkaline batteries. Costco lists a 12-year shelf life and no mercury added.

name: Kirkland Signature Aluminum Foil, 18 in W x 500 ft L
description: Kirkland Signature Aluminum Foil is listed as an 18-inch-wide roll that is 500 feet long. This is the large warehouse foil format sold on Costco.com.

name: Kirkland Signature Plastic Food Wrap, 12 in x 3,000 ft
description: Kirkland Signature Plastic Food Wrap is a 12-inch-wide roll measuring 3,000 feet, listed as 3,000 square feet. The page describes crystal-clear film that clings to metal, glass, trays, and itself, with stretch-to-seal performance for freezer, fridge, and microwave use. It is listed as BPA free and phthalate free, with an optional slide cutter included and a recyclable carton.

description: Kirkland Signature Stretch-Tite Premium Plastic Food Wrap is a 2-count pack, with each roll about 12 inches wide and 758 feet long for 1,500 square feet total. The page lists freezer-to-microwave use, cling to metal, glass, trays, and itself, plus a traditional serrated edge and optional TiteCut slide cutter. It is described as BPA free, phthalate free, and proudly made in the USA.

name: Kirkland Signature Non-Stick Parchment Paper Rolls, 15 in x 164 ft, 2-pack
description: Kirkland Signature Non-Stick Parchment Paper Rolls are a 2-pack of 15 inch by 164 ft rolls, listed as 205 square feet per roll. The page calls it genuine vegetable parchment paper that is FSC certified, kosher, and intended for baking, cooking, and roasting.

name: Kirkland Signature Ultra Shine Liquid Dish Soap, Fresh, 90 fl oz
description: Kirkland Signature Ultra Shine Liquid Dish Soap is a 90 fl oz bottle in a fresh scent. Costco lists platinum performance, 4x grease cutting power, and odor eliminating. It is sold as one liquid bottle.

name: Kirkland Signature Fabric Softener Sheets, 250-count, 2-pack
description: Kirkland Signature Fabric Softener Sheets are sold as a 2-pack of 250-count boxes. The Costco listing is for dryer fabric softener sheets in this warehouse count.

name: Cascade Complete Dishwasher Detergent ActionPacs, Fresh, 93-count
description: Cascade Complete Dishwasher Detergent ActionPacs are a 93-count tub in Fresh scent. Costco lists grease fighting power, cleaning of invisible and visible residue, and a virtually spot free shine. The form is listed as pods for 93 loads.

name: Cascade Platinum Plus Dishwasher Detergent ActionPacs, Fresh, 82-count
description: Cascade Platinum Plus ActionPacs are an 82-count dishwasher detergent in Fresh scent. The page says the formula is loaded with 2X the Dawn grease fighting power and 2X the tough food scrubbers versus Cascade Complete ActionPacs, for up to 100% food residue removal. Pacs are premeasured, phosphate free, and formulated to help prevent hard water spots and filming.

name: Tide Pods with Ultra Oxi Laundry Detergent Pods, 104-count
description: Tide PODS Ultra OXI laundry detergent pacs are a 104-count container in Tide Original scent. The page describes 4-in-1 technology with detergent, stain remover, color protector, and built-in pre-treaters, and says the film dissolves in hot and cold water. Toss the pod in the drum before clothes; it is listed for HE and standard machines.

name: Tide Pods Laundry Detergent Pods, Spring Meadow, 156-count
description: Tide PODS Spring Meadow come as 4 bags of 39 pods, 156 total loads. Each pod is described as a 3-in-1 laundry solution with concentrated detergent, stain remover, and color protector in a three-chamber design. The Spring Meadow scent is listed with fresh floral notes, and the film dissolves in hot and cold water.

name: Tide Pods HE Laundry Detergent Pods, Free & Gentle, 152-count
description: Tide Free & Gentle PODS are a 152-count laundry detergent listed as hypoallergenic, dermatologist tested, and free of dyes and perfumes. The page describes a 3-in-1 clean with concentrated detergent, stain removers, and color protectors, and says each pac works on 100% of common stains even in cold water. Place the pod in the drum before clothing; it is listed for any machine type.

name: Bounty Advanced Paper Towels, 2-Ply, 103 Sheets, 12-count
description: Bounty Advanced Paper Towels are 2-ply towels with 103 sheets per roll. This Costco pack includes 12 rolls.

name: Charmin Ultra Soft Bath Tissue, 2-Ply, 213 Sheets, 30 Rolls
description: Charmin Ultra Soft Bath Tissue is a 30-roll pack of 2-ply tissue with 213 sheets per roll and 4.5 by 4.2 inch sheet size, listed as 835 total square feet. Costco notes septic safe, wider sheets, smooth tear, and describes it as their softest and most absorbent. The listing also says new and improved.

name: Clorox Disinfecting Wipes, Variety Pack, 85-count, 5-pack
description: Clorox Disinfecting Wipes variety pack includes 5 canisters of 85 wipes: 3 Crisp Lemon and 2 Fresh Scent. The page says the bleach-free wipes kill 99.9% of germs including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Salmonella enterica, and Staphylococcus aureus on hard, nonporous surfaces when used as directed. They are listed as safe on over 100 surfaces including finished wood, sealed granite, glass, and stainless steel, and as cleaning 3X better than a wet paper towel versus egg, toothpaste, and dirt.

name: Clorox Clean-Up All Purpose Cleaner with Bleach, Original, 32 fl oz Spray + 180 fl oz Refill
description: Clorox Clean-Up All Purpose Cleaner with Bleach is listed in the original scent. This Costco pack includes a 32 fl oz spray bottle plus a 180 fl oz refill.

name: Reynolds Wrap Heavy Duty Aluminum Foil, 18" x 33.33 yd, 2-count
description: Reynolds Wrap Heavy Duty Aluminum Foil is two individually boxed 18-inch by 33.33-yard rolls, 300 total square feet. The page says the thicker foil withstands high heat in the oven or on the grill, seals in moisture, and protects food in the freezer. An easy-tear cutting edge is listed for measuring sheets, and the foil is described for lining pans, making foil packets, and wrapping leftovers.

name: Reynolds Wrap Aluminum Foil, 12" x 83.33 yd, 2-count
description: Reynolds Wrap Standard Aluminum Foil is two rolls, each 12 inches wide by 250 feet (83.33 yards), for 500 total square feet. The page says it withstands oven heat by sealing in moisture and protects food in the freezer. A standard cutting edge is built into the box, and uses listed include lining pans, covering dishes, tenting roasted meats, and wrapping leftovers.

name: Dawn Platinum Advanced Power Liquid Dish Soap, 90 fl oz
description: Dawn Platinum Advanced Power Liquid Dish Soap is a 90 fl oz bottle in Fresh scent. The page says the improved formula removes 99% of grease and food residue and gives a squeaky clean you can see and feel. Dawn is listed as the #1 dishwashing liquid brand in North America based on sales, and the listing also notes use beyond the sink for pre-treating greasy laundry stains and cleaning counters, appliances, car surfaces, and grill shrouds.

name: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray, Fresh Scent, 1 Starter Kit + 2 Refills
description: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray is a Fresh Scent bundle with 1 spray starter and 2 refills, 48 fl oz total. The page says spray-activated suds cut through grease on contact without water for 5X faster grease cleaning versus non-Ultra Dawn. Instructions are spray, wipe, and rinse; continuous spray is listed for coverage on hard-to-reach items such as blenders and baby bottles.

name: Lysol Disinfectant Spray, Crisp Linen, 19 oz, 3-count
description: Lysol Disinfectant Spray in Crisp Linen (listed as Clean Linen scent) is a 3-can pack of 19 oz sprays. The page says it kills 99.9% of viruses and bacteria on hard surfaces when used as directed, EPA Reg #777-99, including SARS-CoV-2 on hard, non-porous surfaces in 2 minutes. It is listed for frequently touched surfaces, sanitizing soft surfaces, deodorizing air, and eliminating 99.9% of mildew and mold on most household surfaces.

name: Pine-Sol Multi-Surface Cleaner, Original, 60 fl oz, 2-count
description: Pine-Sol Multi-Surface Cleaner, Original, is a 2-count pack of 60 fl oz bottles. The page describes 5X cleaning action that deodorizes, cuts grease, removes grime and dirt, and removes 99% of allergens (non-living dust mite matter and pet dander), with a classic pine scent. The 2X concentrated formula is EPA registered to kill 99% of listed germs when used as directed and is suitable for sealed wood, tile, stone, porcelain, and glass; do not use on marble, aluminum, copper, or unfinished or worn wood.

name: Scrub Daddy Sponges, Colors Variety, 8-count
description: Scrub Daddy Sponges in a colors variety 8-count pack use FlexTexture foam that the page says is soft in warm water and firm in cold water. Listed attributes include scratch free, resists odors, and dishwasher safe. The listing says adjustable scrubbing power cleans with water alone so you can skip harsh chemicals, and notes a minimum order quantity of 2 on Costco.com.

name: Bounce Select a Size Fabric Softener Dryer Sheets, Outdoor Fresh, 400-count
description: Bounce Select a Size Dryer Sheets, Outdoor Fresh, come in a 400-count box, listed as 25% more sheets versus Bounce 320-count. Sheets are perforated so you can use one for small loads, two for average loads, or three for extra-large loads, and each perforated pair is listed as 2X the power versus 1 Bounce Base sheet. The page says they work in all dryer types and fight static and wrinkles, repel pet hair, soften clothes, and add long-lasting freshness.

name: Finish Powerball Quantum Dishwasher Detergent Tabs, 100-count
description: Finish Powerball Quantum Dishwasher Detergent Tabs are a 100-count pack listed with no pre-rinse needed. The page describes three fast-dissolving chambers: powder for stuck-on food, gel for grease, and a liquid Powerball for drying and shine. Finish Quantum with Activelift is described as cleaning 24-hour dried-on food, seeking out tea and coffee stains with bleach in the powder, and providing glass protection in short cycles.

name: Snapware 38-piece Plastic Food Storage Set
description: This Snapware set includes 19 BPA-free plastic containers and 19 lids in seven sizes, from 1.2-cup rounds to 8.5-cup rectangles. Lids have four snap tabs for an airtight, leak-proof seal. Containers are listed as microwave safe, freezer safe, top-rack dishwasher safe, and stackable.

name: Fresh Wave Odor Removing Air Spray, Lemon, 8 fl oz, 4-count

Pour it into the fabric softener dispenser or agitator after adding detergent.

description: Duracell CopperTop AA alkaline batteries with Power Boost Ingredients are sold in a 40-count pack, model MN2400. The page lists long-lasting 1.5-volt performance and a 12-year guarantee in storage. Duracell is listed as the #1 trusted battery brand on the Costco page.
